extraction.name: RoboBench
extraction.description: A comprehensive evaluation benchmark for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) as embodied brains. It defines five dimensions—instruction comprehension, perception reasoning, generalized planning, affordance prediction, and failure analysis—spanning 14 capabilities, 25 tasks, and 6092 QA pairs.
extraction.creator: Yulin Luo, Chun-Kai Fan, Menghang Dong, Jiayu Shi, Mengdi Zhao, Bo-Wen Zhang, Cheng Chi, Jiaming Liu, Gaole Dai, Rongyu Zhang, Ruichuan An, Kun Wu, Zhengping Che, Shaoxuan Xie, Guocai Yao, Zhongxia Zhao, Pengwei Wang, Guang Liu, Zhongyuan Wang, Tiejun Huang, Shanghang Zhang
extraction.citeAs: Luo, Y., Fan, C., Dong, M., Shi, J., Zhao, M., Zhang, B., ... & Zhang, S. (2025). RoboBench: A Comprehensive Evaluation Benchmark for Multimodal Large Language Models as Embodied Brain. arXiv:2510.17801.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Datasets are built from open-source and in-house robotic data, enriched with MLLM- and human-provided annotations. Data combines large-scale real-world robotic datasets with curated in-house collection.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Manual Human Curator, Software Collection
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Large-scale real-world robotic datasets (Fang et al. (2023); Collaboration et al. (2023); Liu et al. (2024c); Wu et al. (2024); Bu et al. (2025)), RoboMIND (Wu et al. (2024)), and in-house collection.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Planning-level failures are synthesized by perturbing correct instructions (wrong object, missing step, wrong order) due to lack of real-world planning failure data. Implicit instructions are obtained by rewriting explicit instructions into demand-based requests using LLMs.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: General and task-specific filters are applied (image quality, task validity, excluding single-arm data from dual-arm tasks). Gemini generates structured annotations which are refined by human annotators. Steps are mapped into function templates grouped into manipulation or navigation skill lists.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Gemini generates structured annotations (task summaries, step-wise instructions, metadata) which are refined by human annotators. Manual annotations of relative positions and keypoint changes are provided for spatial and causal reasoning. Human-labeled bounding boxes link instructions to target objects. Execution-level failures are labeled by experts. 20 professionally trained annotators conduct comprehensive quality inspections.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: A majority-vote strategy is adopted: items that all models solve correctly are removed, whereas items all models fail to solve undergo manual review and correction.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Lack of real-world planning failure data (necessitating synthesis). Execution-level failure diagnosis is intrinsically difficult (human evaluators achieve only 47.30).
